A man being pursued by law enforcement planned with his accomplice to hide inside the coffin at the accomplice’s genuine funeral, then escape after the burial with the accomplice’s help. The accomplice died after making the plan but before the funeral, and the man didn’t know. He climbed into the coffin beside the body, expecting his accomplice to release him afterward. Once the tomb was sealed, he struck a match and recognized the corpse: his accomplice was dead, so the promised rescue would not come. Trapped in the sealed tomb, he died.
